It happens when microscopic physical changes (such as degrading magnetic charges or rotting discs) cause individual binary 0s and 1s to flip. videos.caption: i draw in Clip Studio Paint EX on a Huion Kamvas 20 Pro display tablet. all the brushes are available in my telegram channel @kivsomnia 🩷 💕 yayy i finally got a new phone, not a potato anymore, so i can film in good quality and edit :3 #digitalart #pastelgoth #イラスト #cutecore🍮🐇🎀🎧  #デジタルアート  Pastel Goth is a fashion and visual aesthetic that combines elements of traditional gothic style with soft pastel colors. It emerged as a subculture in the early 2010s through internet fashion communities, especially on platforms like Tumblr. Unlike classic goth fashion, which is usually dominated by black clothing, dark makeup, and a more serious atmosphere, pastel goth mixes dark themes with cute or dreamy visuals. Common colors include pastel pink, lavender, mint, baby blue, and white, often paired with black accents. The style frequently includes oversized sweaters, skirts, platform shoes, chokers, harnesses, fishnets, crosses, chains, bows, and accessories inspired by alternative Japanese fashion. Hairstyles often feature dyed hair in pastel shades such as pink, lilac, or silver. Visually, pastel goth combines motifs like skulls, bats, moons, crosses, and occult symbols with soft elements such as hearts, plush toys, clouds, and candy-like color palettes. This contrast creates an aesthetic that feels both cute and dark at the same time. Pastel goth also strongly influenced digital art, photography, and online aesthetics. In artwork, it is often represented through soft lighting, dreamy pastel tones, melancholic characters, gothic fashion details, and surreal or dark fantasy themes.
